blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship
Known failure modes, engineered out at the architecture level:

items: Override culture
Overrides counted and reviewed monthly — silence around overrides is the finding, not the fix.
OT/IT blur
Plant and enterprise zones separated by design — analytics reads, control stays deterministic.
Twin decay
Twin drift measured against sensors on a schedule — a stale twin is flagged, not trusted.
